overview.text: Today's key developments span architectural improvements, conversational systems, new models, and validation tools. First, cmHC introduces a geometric contraction approach to balance stream mixing in hyper-connections by constraining matrices to the Birkhoff polytope. Second, Duopra extends full-duplex conversational models toward full-duplex agency, incorporating timely tool invocation and argument revision. Third, MemOnce addresses scalable memory architectures for maintaining reusable memory states in long-horizon interactions. Fourth, Clover-35B-A3B-Preview arrives as a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model supporting thinking-mode generation. Finally, new releases and analysis include facebook/sam-3d-body-dinov3, lukendeasy/open-diagram, erkamyaman/safe-anything, NoPeBench for interactive video world models, and formal verification techniques using AI and Lean to combat software slop.

entries.title: cmHC: Balancing Stream Mixing in Hyper-Connections via Geometric Contraction
entries.summary: Manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC) extends residual connections to multiple streams and stabilizes residual propagation by constraining stream-mixing residual matrices to the Birkhoff polytope, the set of doubly stochastic matrices.
entries.why: Stabilizes residual propagation in multi-stream networks using geometric contraction on the Birkhoff polytope.

entries.title: Duopra: From Full-Duplex Conversation to Full-Duplex Agency
entries.summary: Full-duplex interaction models exhibit strong conversational agency, enabling natural, low-latency turn-taking, backchannels, and interruptions. However, completing tasks further requires task agency: timely tool invocation and argument revision following user corrections.
entries.why: Advances conversational models toward task agency with timely tool invocation and argument revision.

entries.title: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
entries.summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures.
entries.why: Provides a scalable memory architecture for maintaining reusable states in long-horizon language model interactions.

entries.title: Prune to Expand: Training Prompt Enhancers with Less to Imitate
entries.summary: Prompt enhancement (PE) refines concise user prompts into detailed descriptions to improve the compositional aesthetics of generated images while preserving user intent.
entries.why: Refines user prompts to improve compositional aesthetics while preserving user intent in image generation.

entries.title: Explicit Style Extraction for Personalized Long-Form Text Generation
entries.summary: Personalized long-form generation asks a language model to write new text the way a specific user would. The standard recipe, retrieval-augmented generation, places a few of the user's past texts in the prompt but leaves the model to decide what to take from them.…
entries.why: Extracts explicit styles to improve personalized long-form text generation over standard retrieval methods.

entries.title: Clover-35B-A3B-Preview Technical Report
entries.summary: We introduce Clover-35B-A3B-Preview (Clover), a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model with 35 billion total parameters and 3 billion activated parameters, supporting thinking-mode generation.
entries.why: Introduces a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model supporting thinking-mode generation.

entries.title: Non-penetrating World Models
entries.summary: We study a new problem of preventing object penetration in interactive video world models. To understand how existing models handle this, we introduce NoPeBench, a benchmark that evaluates how world models respond to physical obstacles.
entries.why: Evaluates and addresses object penetration issues in interactive video world models.

entries.title: facebook/sam-3d-body-dinov3
entries.why: Provides new open weights for specialized 3D body vision tasks.

entries.title: lukendeasy/open-diagram
entries.summary: Python building blocks for dense architecture diagrams that check their own layout · Python
entries.why: Offers Python building blocks for dense architecture diagrams with self-checking layouts.

entries.title: erkamyaman/safe-anything
entries.summary: Find the holes before someone else does. A fast, 100% Rust vulnerability scanner: XSS, SQL injection, leaked secrets, dependency CVEs and AI agent setups. · Rust
entries.why: Delivers a fast Rust vulnerability scanner covering code, dependencies, and AI agent setups.

entries.title: Select Styling Specimens
entries.summary: Tool: Select Styling Specimens I got frustrated at how HTML boxes default to looking different in different browsers, and are (I think) quite ugly in Chrome: So I had Claude Fable 5.2 build me this page showing all of the ways they can be styled: Build an HTML page that shows…
entries.why: Demonstrates practical web styling specimens built using Claude Fable 5.2.

entries.title: The War Against Slop and an Emerging Weapon to Fight it: Formal Verification
entries.summary: Proving software correct with math has traditionally required specialist work. Now AI and Lean are helping automate the process.
entries.why: Explores how AI and Lean automate formal verification to fight software slop.
